description: Evaluation questions for Customer Care: Social Support & Public Sentiment

eval_cases.input: What is our average first response time across social media platforms (X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook)?
What percentage of public social complaints were successfully de-escalated to private direct messages?
What is the average sentiment shift delta before and after social customer support resolutions?
How much attributed revenue has been generated from social DM commerce inquiries this month?
What are the current industry benchmarks for brand response times on TikTok and X for customer support?
